# Genomic instability

This repository is not medical advice.

## Animal data

📚 Annual somatic single-base-substitution rates in intestinal crypts scaled inversely with species lifespan across 16 mammals (Cagan et al., Nature, 2022).

📜 Fucus vesiculosus fucoidan activated SIRT6 and extended median lifespan 13% in aged male mice (Gorbunova et al., bioRxiv, 2025).

## What clinics and self-experimenters are doing

🤔 Off-label weekly sirolimus is commonly 6 mg generic after titration.
